name: FDG (megapack, with parallel and guidance per level)
plain: Paper-form FDG where each level can have its own weight and optional projection. Differs from sd-perturbed-attention, which pins level weights to two values and voids the projection.
math: Per level k: Δ_k=P_c[k]−P_u[k]; g_k=P_u[k]+w_kΔ_k; reconstruct
